description: Use when an agent must identify or vet a US bank: by name or FDIC cert returns FDIC data: active or closed, charter class, regulator, city/state, website, total assets and report date. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /bank/us, $0.005 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. With an access key (Authorization: Bearer p0k_..., buy at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) the tool pays the call itself, returns the data and deducts the price. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

cert.description: FDIC certificate number (1-6 digits). Use name or cert

name.description: Bank name (phrase match; the largest active match is returned, others listed). Use name or cert
